rationale.text: A visible link with href, drawn as a coloured square by CSS, has no content at all, and no aria-label, aria-labelledby or title. The test asks for a name between and , and the methodology for text or an alternative in the content; this link has neither, so it has no name. It has href, so it is a link and not an anchor. The custom check faults it (step 6) through a link whose fault means failure, so the finding is failed at both levels.
